title: Phase-Synchronized Trajectory Optimization in Synthetic Multi-Agent Systems: Adaptive Extended Symplectic Control and Planar Braid Complexity (Version 5.0 Reference Implementation)
description: Official reference computational platform and numerical simulation suite for Phase-Synchronized Trajectory Optimization under Symplectic and Topological Constraints in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems (Version 5.0). Implements the Poincaré adaptive extended symplectic integrator with zero secular energy drift, C^∞ soft-minimum potentials with analytic LogSumExp gradients, post-Newtonian relativistic couplings up to 2.5PN, covariant Kuramoto synchronization on curved Riemannian manifolds, and 2D projected Artin braid group B_N deterministic topological automata.
